name: Protection Of God
overview: The Protection of God is revealed through His intimate care and presence with His people, as seen in Psalms 23:1 where the Lord is portrayed as a shepherd who provides and sustains. Psalm 91:1 emphasizes the security found in dwelling in God's presence, abiding under His protective shadow. Furthermore, Ephesians 5:2 and 5:8 call believers to live in the light of Christ's sacrificial love, signifying that walking in love and light is part of experiencing God's protective guidance and spiritual safety.
